name: mkldnn_reorder_conv2d_weight
description: Representative ATen signature (not an exclusive ABI), copied verbatim from the registered schema: aten::mkldnn_reorder_conv2d_weight(Tensor self, SymInt[2] padding=[0, 0], SymInt[2] stride=[1, 1], SymInt[2] dilation=[1, 1], SymInt groups=1, SymInt[]? input_size=None) -> Tensor. This representative signature is not exclusive: the original Gems pytest owns the full contract of overloads, keyword arguments, returns, errors, aliasing and mutation, and no test may be deleted or reference behavior adapted to fit this single signature. ALL supplied registered schema strings, verbatim: aten::mkldnn_reorder_conv2d_weight(Tensor self, SymInt[2] padding=[0, 0], SymInt[2] stride=[1, 1], SymInt[2] dilation=[1, 1], SymInt groups=1, SymInt[]? input_size=None) -> Tensor ; aten::mkldnn_reorder_conv2d_weight.out(Tensor self, SymInt[2] padding=[0, 0], SymInt[2] stride=[1, 1], SymInt[2] dilation=[1, 1], SymInt groups=1, SymInt[]? input_size=None, *, Tensor(a!) out) -> Tensor(a!). Semantics derived from the tests: a pure CPU oneDNN weight re-layout that consumes an opaque torch._mkldnn conv2d weight (produced by to_mkldnn()) and returns the reordered opaque mkldnn weight tensor for the given padding/stride/dilation/groups attributes; the convolution attributes do not broadcast and the values themselves are preserved bit-exactly, so the default overload is out of place and the operand storage stays untouched. With input_size=None the output geometry is inferred (rank-3 weights pass through unchanged; rank-5 weights collapse to (shape[0]*shape[1], *shape[2:])), while explicit input_size makes input channels equal weight.shape[1] * groups. Native dtype support is float32/float16/bfloat16/int8; uint8 is reachable as a call but has no reorder kernel. Negative forms asserted by pytest: rank-1/rank-2 weights and zero extents, invalid padding/stride/groups/input_size, a non-tensor or dense operand, and an unimplemented-derivative RuntimeError on backward. The .out overload is overload-dependent (conditional) behavior that this single-overload model does not express as effects on the representative signature: it takes a keyword-only out, requires an mkldnn buffer of the result shape and dtype, mutates that buffer and returns it unchanged (res_out is res_buf), and the native .out kernel rejects rank-5 weights. Optional defaults are copied from the registered schema, not inferred from any one benchmark tuple.
